claims.head: Best against best
claims.body: The Oilers are near the top of the league for chance quality, but the Kings are one of the best at preventing dangerous shots. We’ll side with the Kings’ defense.
claims.call: The Kings keep the Oilers’ chances less dangerous than the league average (a 6.3% chance of scoring on the average shot).

claims.head: The Oilers’ power play outclasses the Kings’
claims.body: The Oilers’ power play bites, but the Kings’ doesn’t. Edmonton is the league’s best for the power play, and Los Angeles is near the bottom. Every penalty the Kings take could cost them. Edmonton has had one of the league’s most effective power plays for years.

notes.text: Z. Hyman is out and has missed the last 4 games. He is a top-six forward.
R. Nugent-Hopkins is on injured reserve and has not played this season. He is a top-six forward.
M. Savoie is on long-term injured reserve (lower-body injury) and has not played this season. L. Draisaitl has taken his spot beside C. McDavid and V. Podkolzin.
F. Hållander joined from PIT on Oct 7 and has played beside J. Dickinson and K. Kapanen.
K. Kapanen has started playing on the power play: on the ice for 57% of the team’s power-play time in 5 games, up from 6% last season.
T. Emberson is no longer killing penalties: 2% of the team’s shorthanded time in 3 games, down from 30% last season.
K. Fiala is on injured reserve (lower-leg surgery) and has not played this season. He is one of their most valuable skaters.
A. Turcotte is on injured reserve and missed their last game. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
M. Zuccarello is out and missed their last game. He is a top-six forward.
J. Wright returned in their last game after missing 3 games. Their recent numbers were built mostly without him.

LAK.head: A slightly uphill night for Los Angeles
LAK.body: Edmonton has been out-chancing opponents lately, while Los Angeles will be without Fiala. Edmonton will be without Hyman, while Los Angeles has home-ice advantage, though. Los Angeles can tip it if they keep dangerous shots away.

EDM.head: Edmonton starts a half-step ahead
EDM.body: Edmonton has been out-chancing opponents lately, while Los Angeles will be without Fiala. Edmonton will be without Hyman, while Los Angeles has home-ice advantage, though. It’s still close, though: Los Angeles can make it interesting if they keep dangerous shots away.

story.head: The Oilers come in hot
paras: The Kings are winless in four (0-2-2). The Oilers have won four straight.
